review.identity: Codex automated consistency attribution; no human approval or execution-attestation claim
review.reason: Application/native/distribution and all declared covered inputs match exact preserved observations. New release-only source files and disambiguated parameterized CPU test labels are reviewed outside the unchanged offline authority closure. Local fixture HTTP does not qualify deployed HTTPS or capacity.

limitations: JSON/file consistency is not cryptographic execution, human approval, hardware, or fixture-origin attestation.
Dedicated Mac/Safari/VoiceOver hardware is optional and never a required gate.
Native/format/visual/manual/HTTPS adapters remain explicit pending gates; opaque passed receipts cannot qualify them.
Fixture qualification is limited to hash-bound genuine local A/B/C cohorts, reviewed unchanged covered inputs and actual per-case host observations; it does not establish deployed HTTPS behavior.
Benchmark validation establishes JSON consistency only; no capacity or supported operating budget is inferred.
